record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Waves drive dispatch, and a strip shows progress and parallelism at a glance; with one phase selected the column repeats it.

## Counter-argument

Without the column, the All phases view shows no wave information at all, and a task's wave is one more step away.

payload.alternatives: add the strip and keep the column; keep only the column
payload.choice: The selected phase shows a wave strip with one glyph per task per wave, and the task table drops the wave column

record.subject: wave-strip
